name: headcount_synergy_severance_two_year_cumulative
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A merger eliminates N={POSITIONS} redundant positions with an average fully loaded annual cost of c={COST_PER_POSITION} thousand USD each. Severance paid once at closing equals m={SEVERANCE_MONTHS} months of the annual run-rate savings. Only p={PHASE_IN_PCT} percent of run-rate savings are realized in year 1; year 2 realizes the full run-rate. Compute cumulative net savings at the end of year 2 in USD million (realized savings in years 1 and 2 minus severance).

slots.description: Annual run-rate headcount savings in USD million.

program:
def solve():
    n = P["POSITIONS"]
    c = P["COST_PER_POSITION"]
    m = P["SEVERANCE_MONTHS"]
    p = P["PHASE_IN_PCT"]
    run_rate = Fraction(n * c, 1000)
    severance = run_rate * Fraction(m, 12)
    year_one = run_rate * Fraction(p, 100)
    final = year_one + run_rate - severance
    return {
        "final": final,
        "run_rate_savings": run_rate,
        "severance_cost": severance,
        "year_one_realized": year_one,
    }
